category: in-memory key-value (data structures, Query Engine, JSON)
notes: Redis Open Source 8 (RediSearch/JSON/TimeSeries/probabilistic modules built in). Async primary->replica replication with diskless sync, AOF everysec on both; 3 Sentinels (quorum 2, down-after 2 s) elect a new primary; HAProxy round-robins reads over primary+replica. Documents are hashes with application-maintained index sets/zsets; FT.CREATE on products for text + vector.

orders.method: pipeline HSET (2000/batch) + index sets x4 connections

order_items.method: pipeline HSET (2000/batch) + index sets x4 connections

events.method: pipeline HSET (2000/batch) + index sets x4 connections

schema: hash per document, keys:<coll> sets, application-maintained index sets/zsets, GEOADD geo:customers
FT.CREATE ft:products ON HASH PREFIX products: (description TEXT, embedding VECTOR HNSW cosine)

secondary_index.title: Create a secondary index on a non-key field and use it
secondary_index.detail: no server-side secondary indexes; application-maintained sets/zsets (or RediSearch FT.CREATE)

compound_index.title: Compound / composite index over two fields

unique_constraint.title: Unique constraint on a non-key field (duplicate rejected)
unique_constraint.detail: keys are unique by definition; no constraint on hash fields (SETNX/HSETNX for keys)

ttl_expiry.title: Native per-document/key expiry
ttl_expiry.detail: SET EX / EXPIRE; hash-field TTL (HEXPIRE) in Redis 7.4+/Valkey 9

geo_index.title: Geospatial index and radius query
geo_index.detail: GEOADD + GEOSEARCH (geohash in a sorted set)

partial_update.title: Update a single field without rewriting the document
partial_update.detail: HSET one field of a hash

optimistic_concurrency.title: Compare-and-set / version or ETag-guarded write
optimistic_concurrency.detail: Lua compare-and-set (EVAL) or WATCH/MULTI/EXEC; Valkey 9: SET IFEQ

multi_doc_transaction.title: Multi-document / multi-key ACID transaction with rollback
multi_doc_transaction.detail: MULTI/EXEC: atomic + isolated batch, but no rollback after a failed command (not ACID in the SQL sense)

tunable_consistency.title: Per-request consistency / write concern / read preference
tunable_consistency.detail: WAIT numreplicas timeout -> 1 replicas acked (async replication; WAIT gives per-write synchronous ack)

nested_query.title: Filter on a field inside a nested object
nested_query.detail: flattened hash fields; filtering is client-side (or RediSearch)

array_operators.title: Query and update array-valued fields (contains, push)
array_operators.detail: native list/set types (RPUSH/LPOS/SISMEMBER) rather than arrays inside documents; LPOS -> 1

aggregation.title: Server-side group-by aggregation
aggregation.detail: no GROUP BY; client-side, Lua, or FT.AGGREGATE with RediSearch

server_side_join.title: Join / lookup between two collections inside the engine

server_side_scripting.title: Stored procedures / Lua / JS / UDF executed by the server
server_side_scripting.detail: Lua EVAL -> luax; functions (FUNCTION LOAD) in Redis 7+

pubsub.title: Publish/subscribe messaging built into the engine

explain_plan.title: Query plan / profile output for a query
explain_plan.detail: FT.EXPLAIN for search queries; plain commands have documented O() complexity, no planner

bulk_import.title: Native bulk import path (bulk API, batch, COPY-like tool)

large_document.title: Store and read back a 15 MB document / value
large_document.detail: 15 MB string round-trip ok (limit: proto-max-bulk-len 512 MB)

read_from_replica.title: Client can direct reads to a replica / secondary
read_from_replica.detail: connect to the replica directly (replica-read-only yes); Sentinel clients expose slave_for()

snapshot_backup.title: Online snapshot / backup command available
snapshot_backup.detail: BGSAVE (RDB snapshot) / AOF; Dragonfly: SAVE DF

incremental_backup.title: Incremental / differential backup (file- or segment-level)
incremental_backup.detail: RDB is always a full snapshot; AOF (everysec) is the continuous log between snapshots

pitr.title: Point-in-time recovery from a continuous change log
pitr.detail: AOF replays to the last fsync only — no timestamp-based replay; copy RDBs at the RPO you need

slow_query_log.title: Server-side slow-query log with a configurable threshold
slow_query_log.detail: SLOWLOG (in-memory ring, slowlog-log-slower-than=10000 µs) + LATENCY MONITOR

audit_log.title: Audit / full-query log of statements or auth events
audit_log.detail: ACL LOG (denied AUTH / NOPERM attempts, in memory); no persistent statement audit in OSS (MONITOR is a live stream)

structured_logs.title: JSON-structured server log out of the box
structured_logs.detail: plain-text server log (pid:role date level message); wrap with the docker log driver / a shipper

runtime_log_level.title: Change log verbosity at run time (no restart)
runtime_log_level.detail: CONFIG SET loglevel (current notice), slowlog-*, latency-monitor-threshold apply immediately

strategy.tool: BGSAVE (fork, point-in-time RDB) then copy dump.rdb off the box; AOF everysec keeps the gap between snapshots small
strategy.consistency: point-in-time (fork + copy-on-write); one file per instance
strategy.restore: offline: stop, install the RDB as the multipart-AOF base file (appendonlydir/ + manifest) so an AOF-enabled server loads it, start; replicas full-resync
strategy.incremental: none — RDB is always full; BGREWRITEAOF compacts the AOF
strategy.pitr: no (AOF replays to the last fsync only)
strategy.schedule: `save <seconds> <changes>` rules or a cron job calling BGSAVE + copy (Sentinel/replica-aware)
strategy.retention: external: rotate the copied RDB files

restore.method: stop; RDB -> appendonlydir base + manifest; start; replicas full-resync
restore.sentinel: down-after-milliseconds raised to 600000 on 3 sentinels during the restore, then reset

strategy.server_log: plain text on stdout (`pid:role date level message`), loglevel notice; the docker json-file driver rotates it
strategy.slow_query: SLOWLOG (in-memory ring: slowlog-log-slower-than µs, slowlog-max-len) + LATENCY MONITOR (latency-monitor-threshold ms) + LATENCY DOCTOR
strategy.audit: ACL LOG for denied AUTH / NOPERM attempts (in memory, acllog-max-len); MONITOR is a live debug stream, not a log; persistent audit is Redis Enterprise
strategy.runtime: CONFIG SET loglevel / slowlog-* / latency-monitor-threshold apply immediately (CONFIG REWRITE persists them)
